categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in the cosmetics and personal care industry, with main business segments including skincare products, makeup products, and medical devices. The company's core brands include Winona (薇诺娜), Winona Baby (薇诺娜宝贝), AOXMED (瑷科缦), Beforteen (贝芙汀), Za (姬芮), and PURE&MILD (泊美). The company also operates medical aesthetics clinics and provides functional food products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs self-developed research and manufacturing capabilities combined with contract manufacturing and OEM production models. Core technologies include plant-based active ingredient extraction from Yunnan's unique botanical resources, dermatological formulation development, and clinical efficacy validation. The company operates research institutes in Kunming and Shanghai, with international research collaborations in Japan and France. Production methods include self-manufacturing, contract manufacturing (委托加工), and OEM production for skincare, medical devices, and cosmetics products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves consumers in the skincare and cosmetics market, with particular focus on sensitive skin care segment. Primary customer types include individual consumers through online and offline retail channels, medical institutions, beauty salons, and pharmacies. Major end markets include e-commerce platforms (Tmall, Douyin, JD.com, Pinduoduo), offline retail channels (OTC pharmacies, department stores, specialty beauty stores), and direct-to-consumer channels through company-owned stores and OMO platforms.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with headquarters in Kunming, Yunnan Province. Major operating regions include Shanghai, Hangzhou, Chengdu, Wuhan, and other key cities across China. The company has established international presence with operations in Thailand, Singapore, Japan, USA, and Hong Kong. The company also has operations in Hainan Free Trade Port and maintains regional distribution centers across China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple points in the supply chain. Upstream: the company sources raw materials and botanical ingredients from suppliers and operates its own plant extraction laboratory. Midstream: the company manufactures and processes products through self-owned facilities and contract manufacturers. Downstream: the company distributes products through multiple channels including direct online sales, offline retail partnerships, medical institutions, and beauty clinics. The company also operates its own logistics and warehousing network.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus emphasizes dermatological science and sensitive skin care expertise. R&D priorities include: developing innovative botanical-based active ingredients, advancing formulation technology for sensitive skin, expanding into functional foods and medical devices, establishing international research collaborations, and leveraging AI technology for product development and consumer diagnosis. The company invests significantly in clinical research, consumer studies, and process innovation to maintain competitive advantages in the sensitive skin care segment.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales across multiple channels: online self-operated stores (天猫, 抖音, 京东, 快手), online distribution partnerships, offline retail distribution through pharmacies and specialty stores, direct-to-consumer OMO channels, and medical aesthetics services. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of products or services. The company also generates revenue from medical device sales and functional food products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in China's sensitive skin care market, with its flagship Winona brand ranking first in the dermatological skincare segment with approximately 20.4% market share. The company competes with both international brands (leveraging strong brand heritage and resources) and domestic brands. The company differentiates through specialized focus on sensitive skin, scientific research backing, botanical ingredient expertise, and integrated online-offline distribution model. The company ranks 9th in overall skincare products market and 4th in premium skincare segment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-to-large sized cosmetics manufacturer with 2023 revenue of RMB 5.52 billion, representing 10.14% year-over-year growth. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 756.8 million in 2023, down 28.02% from prior year due to increased marketing investments and operational challenges. The company has shown strong growth trajectory since IPO in 2021, with revenue growing from RMB 4.02 billion in 2021 to RMB 5.52 billion in 2023. Total assets reached RMB 7.51 billion as of December 31, 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's core value proposition centers on scientific, dermatologically-formulated skincare solutions specifically designed for sensitive skin. Key differentiators include: proprietary botanical ingredient extraction technology leveraging Yunnan's unique plant resources, clinical efficacy validation through rigorous testing, professional brand positioning backed by dermatological expertise, integrated OMO (online-merge-offline) sales model providing seamless consumer experience, and commitment to product safety and quality. The company emphasizes the 'Winona for sensitive skin' positioning and has built strong brand loyalty through professional credibility and consumer education.
